title: Simple CMS reset
summary: Converted PAPeR from domain-specific resettlement CMS to Simple CMS with Pages, Posts, Categories, Media. Fresh 8-migration schema; legacy migrations archived.
changes: Added migrations 000-007 for auth, notifications, audit, backup, cms_pages, cms_posts, cms_categories, cms_media
Removed Profile, Structure, Grievance, Library, SES, RAP modules and related API
Added PageController, PostController, CategoryController, MediaController, PublicController
Simplified navigation, dashboard, UserController, bootstrap (no API client gate / IP blocklist)
Updated README, help content, CHANGES, ADR-0011, smoke tests
migration_note: Requires new empty database; run php cli/migrate.php
